$Comment: The yearly keepsake: sit down to the feast with Martha, once a season, and keep the plate.
It inherits the yearly occurrence from Harvest_Feast_Achievement_Base, so each year mints its own
copy and @year in the title reads as that year. Feat files it with the feats, earned only. The
full_table tag counts it toward The Full Table, and season_keepsake toward the Seasons of Orbis
ladder; the feast's Almanac page names this file in Keepsake, and no other Harvest Feast file carries
season_keepsake. It pays nothing itself: the plate is The Feast's own pay
(Quests/SeasonsOfOrbis/_Harvest_Feast/The_Feast.json), collected at the host with the rest, so a
player never has to visit the achievements page for the year's keepsake.
